english.meaning: a point or aspect of something, as in strengths or shortcomings
english.note: Used in compounds like 好處 (benefit) and 不足之處 (shortcoming).

exampleSentences.english: As I said earlier, this book has its strengths, but also its shortcomings.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉正如頭先講呢，就哩一本書呢𠻺有佢嘅好處，但係亦都有不足之處嘅。
